about: Figures of record for the release-readiness review (release-readiness skill 0.4.3, SKILL.md §2 and §2a; fork-local, never upstream). One row per check and metric. A row is of record only with value, version, date and method; until then it says "status": "no record yet" and the review abstains on it (never passes). The row below names the goal in .loop/benchmarks.json (goal:gardenworld/default): once of record, a candidate that does not report the figure, or reports a worse one beyond tolerance, fails the review whatever the goal's mode. A row becomes of record only with a figure measured on master by the goal's own command, in a PR approved by someone other than its author; the review never edits this file.
